messages.subject: Mentor assignments
parts:
Dear Mentors and Students,

Students, please have a look whether your project has possible mentors
listed. If not, please ask your mentor(s) to sign up as possible mentor.
If you don't have a possible mentor, you'll need to find one.

Mentors, please sign up as possible mentors for all "your" proposals. I
(or John) will then assign you as mentor for the moment.

This will be handy for a side-effect:
The mentor interface gained a new column "assigned mentor" which will
hopefully allow us to sort the proposals in a way so that similar
projects come in blocks.

Once we know (in 2 weeks) which proposals are accepted, we can re-assign
the proper mentor out of the co-mentor list.

Claudia
